name: Portfolio allocation mixer
summary: Parse name/weight lines, renormalise weights to 100%, and flag rows that do not add up.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Each line is `name weight`. Weights are scaled so they sum to 1. Does not rebalance a live account.
